titolo: IBM Research releases multilingual Indic voice agent using CUGA harness
descr: A web‑based farm assistant converts spoken Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and other Indian languages to text, searches an English handbook and replies in the original language.
paragrafi: IBM Research published a prototype voice agent on Hugging Face Spaces on November 25, 2026.
The agent listens to a farmer’s question in a regional language, runs speech‑to‑text, searches a 154‑page English agricultural handbook and returns a spoken answer in the same language.
CUGA (ConfigUrable Generalist Agent) provides the agent loop, allowing a single model to be swapped between watsonx and OpenAI with one setting.
Multilingual retrieval works after replacing CUGA’s default English‑only embedding model with intfloat/multilingual‑e5‑large, enabling Hindi or Tamil queries to find correct English passages.
perche: The demo shows how open‑source tooling can bring voice‑first AI services to users who prefer speaking in regional Indian languages. It also illustrates a path for developers to build secure, locally hosted assistants without relying on large English‑only models.
